decisions.statement: The pages judged are asked of the index rather than listed off a folder.
A page is judged from evidence rather than from how old that page is.
Nothing here reads when a page was written.
A live process acting under a page's agent id reads that page as working.
A page read as working is judged working whatever else is known.
A subagent its seat's transcript says is running reads that page as working.
A subagent seen to start and finish under its seat reads that page as stale.
A subagent one subagent dispatched is seen that way as a seat's own is.
Life read in a transcript is weighed before an end read in that transcript.
Life read in a transcript is weighed before every stale rule but the client's own start.
A subagent whose last record came before the start of the client its seat runs now reads as stale.
That start is weighed after a live process and before what a transcript says.
A transcript cannot report an end its client died before writing.
The absence of a running subagent in a transcript makes no page stale.
An agent id a transcript never read a launch receipt for ends no page.
A page no transcript names keeps the judgement the other evidence reached.
A transcript entry naming no agent id joins to no page and changes nothing.
A page stopped from the agents panel reads as stale.
A stop is weighed after every reading of life and every reading of an end.
No stop makes a page working, and no stop makes a working page stale.
A stop settles a page that no other evidence settles.
The stops are handed in rather than read off disk here.
A stop names the page it was written beside rather than an id.
A take-down the seat's log says was refused reads its page as stale.
That log has a line only where a landing refused.
A line in that log is therefore a record rather than an inference.
A take-down is read whether or not that take-down's line opens with a time.
A page whose seat's agent id is carried by no process at all reads as stale.
No command line is read here.
A removal leans on no pattern matching a command line.
A process a seat left behind reads that seat as there.
Every other page reads as undetermined.
A subagent between tool calls answers on no process.
No process is therefore no evidence of an end.
A page stating no agent id is undetermined rather than left out of the census.
A page's seat is the part of its agent id before the mark.
The census names for every page its seat and its agent id and the processes answering and why.
Nothing here writes a page.
Nothing here removes a page.
Nothing here commits.
The processes read off /proc are handed in rather than read here.
The evidence a seat's transcript has is handed in rather than read here.

definition: every subagent page the index has, each judged working, stale or undetermined
